title: game/npcs/<id>.json
description: One NPC (CONTENT_PLAN C08; schema 2, VILLAGE_PLAN V01): only what no other file holds, and what it does that was code: the prompt it waits on in each state, the host event it opens a talk with, its voice and the key words it shows first. Loaded by NpcRoster (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

id.description: The agent id, the file's name: agents/<id>.json has the same id, the scene places it, the saves name it.

label.description: The target-language label over the head and on the dialogue panel (Guía).

name.description: The NPC's own name (Luna); the beacon shows it, or the label when there is none.

figure.description: The key of the NPC's figure: its colours, geometry and face are drawn by the game.

focus.description: By prompt of this NPC: the learner phrases it practises (they are at home with this NPC and have a scaffold to fade).

prompts.description: By state of the NPC's agent: the prompt it waits on in that state (idle: stall-need, offering: stall-offer). A state not listed waits on the prompt of the agent's initial state. The key review is no state: it names the prompt of the guide's review question (guide-review).

event.description: The host event the game raises to the agent when the talk opens (villager.greet); a state of agents/<id>.json takes it with onHostEvent. A state that does not take it opens with the prompt's text.

when.description: always: at every opening; first: at the first talk only, while the agent is in its initial state; never: the prompt's text opens every talk (the event is then not raised).

opening.description: How the NPC opens a talk. Behaviour the data cannot say stays code, by id: the guide's transfer offer and the shopkeeper's later visits (the bottle is never withheld).

speaker.description: The Kokoro speaker id (kokoro-multi-lang-v1_0 has 54 speakers, 0 to 53; docs/nlp/API.md section 6): 28 ef_dora, 29 em_alex, 53 em_santa.

name.description: The voice's name in the model's table (em_alex), written into the speech index and the provenance.

speed.description: The speed of the normal recordings (default 1.0); the slow ones are 0.8 of it.

gain.description: The factor the renderer scales the voice's samples by (default 1.0; VILLAGE_PLAN V11): a voice the model renders louder or quieter than the Spanish ones is brought to their level (the baker's if_sara, about three times louder, takes 0.32).

voice.description: The voice the speech renderer records the NPC's lines with (tools/Vocaterra.SpeechRender).

keyWords.description: The key words (catalogue nouns) whose cards the NPC shows alone before its first question (the shopkeeper's agua and pan); moved here from game/words.json.

poolPrefix.description: The name the NPC's dialogue pools carry when it is not the id (the shopkeeper's are shop_* and guide.lesson.shop.*): its pools are <poolPrefix>_* and guide.lesson.<poolPrefix>.*, and they speak with its voice.
